subject: Bridgewire trial: onramp playbook & connectivity checklist
messages:
From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@medsync.com>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Bridgewire trial: connectivity & onboarding ask

Hi Tessa / Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at MedSync is excited to kick off the short trial. We want to align on the immediate gating items so engineering can provision the test environment this week. High level asks:

- Org setup: create a customer org for medsync (tenant id and admin invite).
- API keys: one short-lived key for dev sandbox + usage key for evaluation.
- IP allowlist: we'll provide our egress ranges; need the list you expect on your side.
- VPC peering: we prefer a peering for low-latency evaluation (AWS us-west-2).

Could you put together a concise checklist / timeline (1–2 pages) with owners and the minimal artifacts we should provide? Our target is to start traffic by Nov 24 if possible.

Alex (cc'd) will be the network lead and can share diagrams — Alex, loop in whatever I missed.

Thanks,
Sam Patel
Head of Platform Integrations
MedSync

Attachment: medsync_network_diagram.png (image stub)
From: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@medsync.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Bridgewire trial: connectivity & onboarding ask

Thanks Sam — great to hear. I captured a compact mutual-action playbook that covers the exact gating steps and proposed owners. I attached the one-page PLAYBOOK (map_bridgewire_v1.pdf) — TL;DR below and proposed dates.

TL;DR (owners + dates)
- Wednesday Nov 17: Redwood creates medsync org, invites primary admin (owner: Tessa)
- Thursday Nov 18: API keys provisioned (short-lived dev + evaluation key) (owner: Platform Ops / Neha)
- Friday Nov 19: Customer shares network egress IP ranges + diagram (owner: MedSync / Alex)
- Monday Nov 22: VPC peering kickoff (owner: Redwood Infra / Karthik)
- Wednesday Nov 24: Smoke traffic & basic acceptance (both)

Minimal artifacts we need from you now:
- CIDR list (or single egress IP ranges) for your firewall allowlist
- Network contact for peering (name, email, AWS account id)
- Acceptance smoke test checklist sign-off (I included a short template in the attached PLAYBOOK)

Note on security: we will route trial traffic to a dedicated tenant in our staging cluster and we can enable request-level logging for the evaluation window if you want audit visibility. If you prefer an isolated Dedicated pool, we can scope that in a follow-up but it will add lead time.

Next steps: If the dates above look good, I'll schedule a 30-minute network handoff with Karthik + Alex for Friday afternoon (Nov 19).

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
phone: +1 650 555 0147

Attachment: map_bridgewire_v1.pdf (pdf stub)
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@medsync.com>, tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 13:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Bridgewire trial: connectivity & onboarding ask

Sam / Tessa — I'll own the peering side. Quick technical notes to speed handoff: 

- Preferred peering: AWS VPC Peering (us-west-2). We can also do Transit Gateway if you need multiple VPCs.
- Required items from MedSync network team:
  * AWS account id for peering
  * VPC cidr for their peering VPC (no overlap with our staging 10.32.0.0/16)
  * Representative contact (name / email / phone) who can accept the peering request and coordinate route table updates
- For IP allowlist (ingress to MedSync): we'll provide the outbound egress ranges from our sandbox; for short trials the recommended approach is to allow the following ranges on your firewall: 52.41.120.0/24, 34.210.88.0/22 (these are staging egress prefixes). If you require FQDN allowlisting, let me know and we can provide FQDNs for the API endpoints.

I can run the peering request as soon as Alex shares the AWS account id and the VPC cidr. Proposed calendar: 30m handoff on Fri Nov 19 3pm PT.

-karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Infra Engineer — Redwood Inference
